environment.downloads: Blob creation and filename dispatch captured; OS download not validated

scope_notice: Real Chromium DOM/CSS and production UI/DOM-adapter code. Origin storage, Web Locks, clipboard, download dispatch and Chrome extension APIs are shimmed in the UI harness. This is NOT proof of native extension, real React/Vue libraries, real corporate recruiting portals or store approval.
